comments.value:
As a PC user I have seen worlds with solutions to most of these. I've seen worlds that black out the view when leaning a head through a wall.

I've seen worlds that really react funny to flying.

I've even seen worlds that the camera trick doesn't work for. 

Flying is really handy for looking at how a world is constructed. For the people uploading game levels to VRChat, I'm not sure how many of those would add a flying prefab. But I like looking from outside a level

@{618ece8f22b63e309408b761|full_name}

1: Flying around on game maps can be annoying to other players, but you can already prevent it with an Udon script.

2: It sounds like ya had a rough experience there. Sorry for this.

But personally, I wouldn't be in such toxic groups. 

I see this feature as useful because you can remove trolls, toxics  and cheaters.

3: When you upload worlds, look on the VRC website,  you can reduce avatar scaling there.

4: You could do this easily by writing a shader or Udon behavior.

5: Same as number 4, but more tricky. You can code a shader and make a function check if the remote player is visible, or maybe disable it using a dummy shader. Look up these useful functions:

https://github.com/cnlohr/shadertrixx 

especially the section: "Are you in a mirror?"

6: I feel you. Unfortunately, EAC is provided by an external company; as far as I know, they don't make Android builds or iOS builds, and it's also hard for them to make one as they use kernel privileges to stop these user land cheaters.

Overall, I think the changes that you addressed would make the process easier to make game maps but drastically reduce the generally useful features,  and user-dependent moderation.

details:
1. remove the ability for avatars to fly as people mainly use it to be malicious on games, there is addons that developers can add to the game to allow flying so avatars even having this ability in the first place is bad. (could also make a setting for developers to enable flying but since it already has addons and such for it it may not be needed since a developers who wants people to have that ability can just add it.)

2. remove the ability of a group owner to kick &/ or warn someone as it also gets abused in a public setting by bad actors, instead it should be made where there has to be at least 3-4 group members in the server that get a notification to do it (alot like a vote to kick) or just give developers the ability to turn that off entirely. (ive watched people just host a game and just kick everyone that played better then them multiple times.)

3. reduce avatar scaling as people tend to go to its max making it where everyone cant see what is actually going on making it where someone has to hide other avatars (personally i dont wanna be hiding people's avatar because they want to be malicious with it.)

4. add something to prevent people from looking through walls since its been abused for a very very long time

5. add a setting to the "Standard Lite" shader that disable's mirrors ability to only show players and nothing else or some setting in mirrors that disables other player's visibility since people use that to gain a unfair advantage extremally often

6. eac is unforgiving to people who "mod"/ cheat on whatever it is protecting and low and behold! questies are using these cheats to abuse udon, fly & more (from what ive seen EAC has worked really well on PC to prevent these things from happening.)
title: EAC on quest and more!
